name: awaken2d
description: AI-friendly 2D skeletal animation toolkit (Spine/Live2D-like) with text model format, headless renderer, CLI and MCP server.

scripts.example:character: npm run example:psd && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/cli/main.ts import examples/psd-demo/character.psd examples/psd-demo/character.rig.json --target spine --propose --ik --physics --force && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/cli/main.ts apply examples/psd-demo/character.rig.json examples/psd-demo/animate.ops.json
